newsitem.title: FRANCE: BA willing to buy Airbus very large plane.
newsitem.headline: BA willing to buy Airbus very large plane.

text.p: British Airways Plc chief executive Bob Ayling said on Thursday his company was willing to buy the very large aircraft currently being developed by Airbus Industrie.
"I have told (Airbus managing director Jean) Pierson that we are in the market for such a plane. We believe it is the plane for the future," Ayling told a news briefing during a visit to France.
He said the final decision whether to buy the plane would depend on whether Airbus could meet BA's needs and whether the price would be competitive.
He said BA specialists were already working with Airbus at the aircraft maker's headquarters in Toulouse, southern France, on the design.

Airbus Industrie is a consortium made up of French state-owned Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
